uncited: Line and Edge Detection is a family of non-photorealistic volume rendering techniques that enhance perceptual clarity by explicitly detecting and rendering edges, silhouettes, or structural boundaries within volumetric data.

It distinguishes itself from sibling methods like [Line Illustration Detection](772-line-illustration-detection.md) by focusing on boundary emphasis and structural outlines rather than flow-aligned strokes, and from [LOG-based Silhouette Detection](6322-log-based-silhouette-detection.md) by employing diverse detection mechanisms ranging from gradient-based particle tracing to user-defined interactive selection.
Line and edge detection techniques in volume rendering utilize various strategies to highlight structural boundaries.
